**Question:** As of May 20, 2026, what was The J.M. Smucker Company's most recently reported quarterly adjusted EPS (state the fiscal quarter), and what fiscal 2026 net sales growth guidance range was in effect?

- As of May 20, 2026, The J.M. Smucker Company's most recently reported quarter was the third quarter of fiscal 2026, the quarter ended January 31, 2026, announced on February 26, 2026. [1]
- For Q3 FY2026 (quarter ended January 31, 2026), adjusted earnings per share - assuming dilution was $2.38, a non-GAAP measure, a decrease of 9 percent versus the prior-year quarter. [1]
- For the same Q3 FY2026 quarter (ended January 31, 2026), GAAP net loss per diluted share was $6.79, reflecting noncash impairment charges attributable to the Sweet Baked Snacks reporting unit. [1]
- The fiscal 2026 net sales growth guidance in effect as of May 20, 2026, as updated in the Q3 FY2026 release, was a net sales increase of 3.5% to 4.0% versus the prior year (current guidance), narrowed from the previous range of 3.5% to 4.5%. [1]
- The change in the midpoint of the fiscal 2026 net sales guidance range reflected the estimated impact of a February fire at the Company's Emporia, Kansas manufacturing facility, while adjusted earnings per share guidance of $8.75 to $9.25 and free cash flow expectations were maintained. [1]
- The fiscal 2026 net sales guidance also included comparable net sales expected to increase approximately 5.0 to 5.5 percent, excluding noncomparable prior-year sales related to the divestitures. [1]
